        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int btcAmount = sc.nextInt();
        int[] btcCosts = new int[100];

        int pendingValue = 0;

            int current = (pendingValue != 0) ? pendingValue : sc.nextInt();
            pendingValue = 0;

            else oddCount++;

                pendingValue = sc.nextInt();
                int cost = Math.abs(current - pendingValue);
                btcCosts[cost]++;
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
            }
        }
        int count = 0;
        int cumulativeCost = 0;
        for (int cost = 0; cost < 100; cost++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < btcCosts[cost]; k++) {
                cumulativeCost += cost;
                if (cumulativeCost <= btcAmount) {
                    count++;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
